name: Single Knee to Chest Stretch
steps: Lie flat on your back on the floor with your legs extended or knees comfortably bent.
Lift one leg and bring your knee up toward your chest.
Clasp both hands around your shin or the back of your thigh behind your knee.
Gently pull your knee closer to your chest until you feel a comfortable stretch in your lower back, buttocks, and hip.
Hold the stretch for 15 to 30 seconds while keeping your opposite leg relaxed on the floor.
Slowly release your leg back down, then switch sides.
coaching_cues: Grasp behind your thigh if pulling on your shin causes knee discomfort.
Keep your head and shoulders resting comfortably on the floor.
Breathe deeply and sink into the stretch with each exhalation.
